title: Food & Beverage
summary: Food traceability requires unified management of lot genealogy, CCP records, and inspection data from raw material intake to shelf.

needs.title: Raw material to shelf lot genealogy
needs.description: Record which lot, recipe, and shift produced each final batch.

needs.title: Critical Control Point data
needs.description: Capture metal detector, check-weigher, and pasteurization time-temperature records.

needs.title: CIP/SIP process validation
needs.description: Track cleaning and sterilization circulation, temperature, and duration.

needs.title: Fast and narrow recall execution
needs.description: Target only affected lots instead of broad recall actions.

needs.title: MES to ERP synchronization
needs.description: Consistent recipe, allergen, and shipment data across systems.

solutions.title: OnSuite Trace
solutions.description: Lot management, product genealogy, and critical component control.

solutions.title: OnSuite Connect
solutions.description: PLC integration for metal detectors, check-weighers, and filling equipment.

solutions.title: OnSuite Forms (DSF)
solutions.description: CCP/HACCP field forms and audit evidence records.

solutions.title: OnSuite Integra
solutions.description: MES-ERP bridge for synchronized recipe, allergen, and shipment data.

results.title: Significantly reduced recall scope
results.description: Affected lots can be isolated precisely instead of mass recalls.

results.title: Auditable CCP evidence
results.description: Temperature, weight, and reject data are linked to each lot.

results.title: Faster HACCP and ISO readiness
results.description: Weeks of manual pre-audit data consolidation are eliminated.

results.title: Improved export compliance
results.description: Production is aligned with traceability expectations for EU markets.
